evidence: The as-deposited films were practically amorphous, although an unidentiﬁed x-ray reﬂection at approximately 9° 2θ was detected in the thickest ﬁlms deposited using 500 cycles. The ﬁlm thickness of approximately 5.5 nm, corresponding to about nine monolayers of WS2, was in excellent agreement with XRR (5.3 nm).
